features.description: SQLite SharedCache implementation with two-tier BrainStore (user + project), search (SimHash + FTS5), GC, and persistent storage
acceptance_criteria: SQLiteSharedCache passes all existing SharedCache interface tests
BrainStore queries both user + project brains, merges with project boost
ailang cache promote copies frame from project to user brain
SimHash search returns top-K results with deterministic ordering
FTS5 keyword search returns relevant results
GC removes expired frames based on TTL
Concurrent stress test passes (100 goroutines)
Data persists across process restarts
make test and make lint pass

features.description: ailang cache CLI: search, list, put, put-resolution, stats, gc, export/import
acceptance_criteria: ailang cache search returns relevant results in <100ms
ailang cache list --recent shows newest frames
ailang cache put stores frame with correct namespace and SimHash
ailang cache put-resolution creates resolution frame from commit info
ailang cache stats shows namespace breakdown and storage size
ailang cache gc removes expired frames
ailang cache export | ailang cache import round-trips cleanly
make test and make lint pass

features.description: Claude Code hooks: session start context injection, post-commit resolution capture, edit capture
acceptance_criteria: Session start hook injects relevant brain context (top-3 frames)
Post-commit hook captures resolution frames automatically
Hooks are async and don't add >200ms to any tool call
Brain hooks can be disabled via config
Hooks work when brain.db doesn't exist yet (graceful bootstrap)
make test and make lint pass
